title: 第15章 林北震惊第16章 菲姐受伤
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
何清瑶迫不及待地走进卧室，看到床上睡得安稳、脸色红润的妹，悬了半年的心终于落了下来。
眼眶一热，激动得差点哭出声，连忙用手捂住了嘴，生怕吵醒何清妍。
“让她好好睡一觉吧，等她睡醒了，就彻底没事了。”陈阳的声音从身后传来。
何清瑶轻轻退出卧室，小心翼翼地关上房门，转身看向陈阳，脸上满是感激：“陈大师，这真是太感谢你了！”
“你就是我们何家的大恩人！”
“不客气，举手之劳。”陈阳摆了摆手，“你妹已经谢过我了。”
“我还有事，就先告辞了。”
陈阳话音刚落，转身就要走。
何清瑶连忙快步追上，拦住他的去路，语气急切又诚恳：“陈大师，等等！”
“麻烦你提供一下银行账号，我好给你支付治疗费。”
陈阳心里泛起一丝犹豫。
说实话，他从何清妍身上已经获得了天大的好处。
不仅补充了真气，还成功开启了治疗神功，更何况他还是何清妍的第一个男人。
从这个角度来说，他确实不好意思再收钱。
可他转念一想，何清瑶如此看重妹的病情，自己若是分文不取，她恐怕会觉得亏欠自己，反而不会轻易放自己走。
陈阳索性掏出手机，调出自己的银行卡相片，亮给何清瑶看，语气平淡说：“何小姐，那你就转十万块给我吧。”
“十万？”何清瑶愣住了，一双漂亮的眼睛瞪得溜圆，几乎以为自己听错了。
她本以为陈阳救了妹的命，至少要索要数百万甚至上千万的诊费。
没想到对方只要十万，这简直超出了她的预料。
“对，就十万。”陈阳肯定地点了点头。

何清瑶回过神来，连忙拿出自己的手机，对着卡号拍了张照片，确认无误后才说：“好，陈大师，我一会就安排人给你转过去。”
陈阳收回手机，不再多言，转身朝着外边走去。
陈阳刚一出来，守在门外的孙雪儿当即眼睛一亮，像只受惊后找到主人的小兽一样，快步扑了过来。
一把抓住陈阳的胳膊，语气里满是担忧和急切：“阳哥，你可算出来了！她们没把你怎么样？有没有为难你？”
“没有，就是帮她们解决了点小问题。”陈阳拍了拍她的手背，安抚道：“我们走吧。”
孙雪儿这才松口气，紧紧跟在陈阳身边。
两人快步朝着电梯走去。
身后，何清瑶带着冷酷西装女苏影追了出来。
她刚想开口再说些感谢的话，就见陈阳和孙雪儿已经走进了电梯。
电梯门缓缓关上，隔绝了她的视线。
何清瑶无奈地停下脚步。
苏影忍不住问：“小姐，二小姐真的没事了？”
何清瑶重重地点了点头，脸上露出如释重负的笑容，轻轻舒了口气：“没事了，陈大师已经把她治好了，现在就等她醒来了。”
压在她心头半年的巨石终于落地，她整个人都轻松了不少。
“那就好。”苏影也松了口气。
何清瑶眼神微微一凝，吩咐道：“苏影，你去让人查一下陈大师的所有信息，越详细越好。”
“是，小姐。”苏影恭敬地应了一声。
另一边。
陈阳带着孙雪儿从新葡酒店出来后，径直赶往关口。
此时天色已经渐渐暗了下来，博城的街头亮起了璀璨的灯光，比白天更显繁华。
content_en:
He Qingyao couldn't wait to walk into the bedroom. When she saw the girl sleeping peacefully on the bed with a rosy face, her heart finally dropped after half a year of hanging.
Her eyes were hot, and she was so excited that she almost cried. She quickly covered her mouth with her hands for fear of waking He Qingyan.
"Let her have a good sleep. When she wakes up, she will be completely fine." Chen Yang's voice came from behind.
He Qingyao quietly exited the bedroom, carefully closed the door, turned to look at Chen Yang, her face full of gratitude: "Master Chen, thank you so much!"
"You are our great benefactor to the He family!"
"You're welcome, it's just a little effort." Chen Yang waved his hand, "Your sister has already thanked me."
"I have something else to do, so I'll take my leave now."
As soon as Chen Yang finished speaking, he turned around and left.
He Qingyao hurriedly caught up with him, blocked his way, and said in an urgent and sincere tone: "Master Chen, wait!"
"Please provide your bank account number so I can pay for your treatment."
Chen Yang felt a trace of hesitation in his heart.
To be honest, he has benefited greatly from He Qingyan.
Not only did he replenish his energy, but he also successfully activated the magical healing power, not to mention that he was He Qingyan's first man.
From this perspective, he was really embarrassed to collect money.
But then he thought about it, He Qingyao valued his sister's condition so much that if he didn't take any money from her, she might feel that she owed him and would not let him go easily.
Chen Yang simply took out his mobile phone, pulled up his bank card photo, showed it to He Qingyao, and said in a calm tone: "Miss He, please transfer 100,000 yuan to me."
"One hundred thousand?" He Qingyao was stunned, her beautiful eyes widened, and she almost thought she heard wrong.
She originally thought that Chen Yang would ask for at least millions or even tens of millions in medical fees for saving her sister's life.
Unexpectedly, the other party only wanted 100,000 yuan, which was beyond her expectation.
"Yes, just one hundred thousand." Chen Yang nodded affirmatively.
He Qingyao came to her senses, quickly took out her mobile phone, took a photo of the card number, and then said after confirming it was correct: "Okay, Master Chen, I will arrange for someone to transfer it to you in a minute."
Chen Yang took back his phone, said no more, turned and walked outside.
As soon as Chen Yang came out, Sun Xueer, who was guarding the door, immediately opened his eyes and rushed over like a frightened little beast that found its owner.
He grabbed Chen Yang's arm, his tone full of worry and urgency: "Brother Yang, you figured it out! Didn't they do anything to you? Did they make things difficult for you?"
"No, I just helped them solve a small problem." Chen Yang patted the back of her hand and said comfortingly: "Let's go."
Sun Xueer breathed a sigh of relief and followed Chen Yang closely.
The two of them walked quickly towards the elevator.
Behind him, He Qingyao chased out with the cold-suited girl Su Ying.
Just as she was about to say some more words of thanks, she saw Chen Yang and Sun Xueer already walking into the elevator.
The elevator door slowly closed, cutting off her sight.
He Qingyao stopped helplessly.
Su Ying couldn't help but ask: "Miss, is the second lady really okay?"
He Qingyao nodded heavily, with a relieved smile on her face, and breathed a sigh of relief: "It's okay, Master Chen has cured her, and now we're just waiting for her to wake up."
The boulder that had been weighing on her heart for half a year finally fell to the ground, and she felt a lot more relaxed.
"That's good." Su Ying also breathed a sigh of relief.
He Qingyao's eyes narrowed slightly and he ordered: "Su Ying, go and have someone check all the information about Master Chen. The more detailed the better."
"Yes, Miss." Su Ying responded respectfully.

At this time, the sky was gradually getting dark, and the streets of Bo City were lit up with bright lights, making them more prosperous than during the day.
